purpose: Phase-2 anatomical registry for the Profile-B simulator. Defines ONLY the five skin layers, their biologically correct ORDERING, schematic draw weights, the scale-level -> visibility mapping, static scenes, labels, and an illustrative palette. Loaded by the app; the code hardcodes NO biological values.

scientific_integrity.ordering_confidence: CONTEXTUAL_ANATOMY - the top-to-bottom ordering (air -> surface -> stratum corneum -> viable epidermis -> dermis -> subcutis) is textbook consensus (OpenStax A&P 5.1 CC BY; StatPearls NBK537325).
scientific_integrity.proportion_confidence: NOT_REPORTED as measured layer thicknesses in the frozen evidence. Chen 2012 reports 0-30/30-60/60-90 um SAMPLING sections (NOT layer thicknesses); PMC5620574 notes rodent viable epidermis ~20 um. Therefore draw weights below are ORDINAL-consensus only and the whole cross-section is flagged not_to_scale.
scientific_integrity.rule: draw weights encode the qualitative rank (SC thinnest < viable epidermis < dermis thickest; subcutis variable). They are NOT measured ratios and must be labelled 'schematic, not to scale' in the UI.

palette.note: ILLUSTRATIVE_COLOR only - restrained, muted, flat fills to DISTINGUISH regions. No gradients, no glow, no concentration/activity encoding.

layers.name: Stratum Corneum
layers.measured_thickness: NOT_REPORTED (Chen 0-30 um SAMPLING section, not a layer thickness)

layers.name: Viable Epidermis
layers.role: living epidermal layers below the stratum corneum
layers.thickness_basis: ordinal consensus: thicker than SC, thinner than dermis
layers.measured_thickness: NOT_REPORTED (rodent viable epidermis ~20 um per PMC5620574; not a Profile-B measured value)

layers.name: Subcutaneous Tissue
layers.role: hypodermis (orientation-only; not reached by Profile-B evidence)

scale_levels.note: Populates the Phase-1 ScaleSystem (L1..L6). depth_window is a [top,bottom] fraction of the full tissue stack (0=surface top, 1=subcutis bottom). emphasized = layers drawn at full opacity; others dimmed. clip = cross-section exposes all layers at overview.

scenes.note: clean cross-sectional cut exposing all layers

labels.note: Anatomical names only (no explanatory text in Phase 2). Placed at band centre; hidden when a band is below the min pixel height.
